heading.title: Discover the Power of Rapid Recap

benefits.title: MULTI CATEGORIES NEWS
benefits.text:
Stay ahead with Rapid Recap! Explore the latest news and trends across Top, General, Business, Technology, Entertainment, Sports, Science, Health, and more.
 Stay informed, stay updated, and never miss out on the latest happenings around the globe. Dive into a world of information!

benefits.title: IQ SCORE
benefits.text:
Boost your Information Quotient (IQ) Score! Your IQ score reflects your knowledge bank, increasing with each quiz you conquer.
 Engage more, score higher, and watch your IQ soar. Challenge yourself and climb the leaderboard!

benefits.title: RQM SCORE
benefits.text:
Master the Rapid Quiz Mastery (RQM) Score! Your RQM score is calculated based on accuracy and speed in answering quizzes.
Sharpen your skills, answer swiftly, and rise to the top. Become the ultimate quiz master!

benefits.title: Societies and Circles
benefits.text:
Join elite Societies and Circles! These groups celebrate different cognitive abilities and foster intellectual growth.
Advance through levels like Visionaries and Pioneers in the Mavericks Society, or Scholars and Masters in the Elites Society. Elevate your intellect!

benefits.title: Experience Level
benefits.text:
Earn XP (Experience Points) for your activities! Gain points through quizzes and site engagement.
Upgrade your Society or Circle with calculated XP based on IQ thresholds. Achieve accurate rewards and celebrate your progress!

benefits.title: Streak Systems and Boosts
benefits.text:
Unlock rewards with our Streak Systems!
Daily Streaks grant a 1.5x RQM score after 6 days of continuous activity.
Quin Boost Streaks offer a 1.5x RQM score on the 6th quiz of the same day. Keep the streaks alive!
